sample_description: undoped sol-gel dip-coated TiO2 thin film (titanium isopropoxide, 5 layers) on p-Si wafer
conditions: annealed 500 °C, 2 h; dopant=0; measured at room temperature
notes: paper: B1g in text, A1g on Fig. 4 (single band). SUBSTRATE CAUTION: the films are on p-type (100) Si wafers (p.2) and the paper never mentions the Si line. On Fig. 4 the '522' arrow points at a sharp, narrow line in the 1 wt% Ce film spectrum (the Si first-order line, 520.7 cm-1; the 0.1 wt% Eu spectrum shows the same sharp line at ~547 with its whole spectrum shifted up), while the broad pure-film doublet peaks near 516-520 cm-1 (review pixel reading ~519.5). The printed 522 probably follows the Si substrate line rather than the anatase doublet; kept as printed, use with caution
